jen_support: Hey team — customer (acme) reporting intermittent 502s on /v1/chat and occasional 401s. Need a minimal repro to attach to the ticket: curl + small Python/JS/Go snippets, plus the exact request IDs and any client logs. Example request id we saw in their log: req_0c9a2b3d. Can someone paste compact repros I can forward?

acme-dev: Saw it ~2026-03-16T17:22:11Z. Sample req id: req_0c9a2b3d. Minimal curl we tried:```bash
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```

raj: Quick checklist for repro capture: include exact timestamp, full response headers, and X-Request-ID from response. Here's a compact curl I send to support:```bash
curl -v --compressed https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: client-req-12345" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}]}'
```

olivia: Python snippet (requests) — include logging and print headers/response:```python
import requests, os
url = "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY')}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
payload = {"model":"rwd-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}
r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=20)
print(r.status_code)
print(r.headers)
print(r.text)
# note: capture stdout logs and client network trace if possible
```

olivia: JS (fetch) minimal:```javascript
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwd-3b', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] }),
});
console.log(res.status, Object.fromEntries(res.headers));
console.log(await res.text());
```

raj: Go minimal (net/http) — helpful to capture response headers:```go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "os"
)
func main(){
  body := []byte(`{"model":"rwd-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST","https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  client := &http.Client{}
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  if err != nil { fmt.Println("err", err); return }
  fmt.Println("status", resp.StatusCode)
  fmt.Println("headers", resp.Header)
}
```

infra-bot: Found backend trace for req_0c9a2b3d — worker timed out while waiting for model weight load, see trace: https://logs.redwood.example/trace/req_0c9a2b3d (internal id: trace-9f3a). Also captured remote IP and route.

jen_support: Perfect. Please upload a debug bundle to the ticket with: 1) the request id(s) (e.g., req_0c9a2b3d), 2) client logs (stdout/stderr from SDK or HTTP client), 3) response headers (full), 4) SDK versions, 5) timestamps (UTC), and 6) egress/NAT IPs. If possible include tcpdump or proxy logs. I'll escalate to infra with the trace link.
